text: His father, if possessed of less vigor than his predecessors, was yet a man of culture and ability.
zh: 他的父亲虽然没有前辈那么有活力，但也是一个有文化、有能力的人。
chunks: His father, if possessed
of less vigor
than his predecessors,
was yet a man
of culture and ability.

text: Though intensely religious, he did not feel called to the ministry; business made no appeal; his ancestors had been lawyers; it seemed best that he should follow where they had led.
zh: 尽管他非常虔诚，但他并不觉得自己被召唤去传教。企业未提出上诉；他的祖先曾是律师；看来他最好跟随他们的脚步。
chunks: Though intensely religious, he did not feel called
to the ministry; business made no appeal;
his ancestors had been lawyers;
it seemed best that he should follow
where they had led.

text: At the hands of the people this came to him in smallest measure only.
zh: 在人民手中，他得到的只是最小的一点。
chunks: At the hands
of the people this came to him in smallest measure only.

text: He was buried in Rome in the Protestant Cemetery, whose cypresses cast their long shadows over the graves of many distinguished foreigners who have sought a last refuge of health and peace under the skies of Italy.
zh: 他被埋葬在罗马的新教公墓，那里的柏树在许多杰出的外国人的坟墓上投下长长的阴影，这些外国人在意大利的天空下寻求健康与和平的最后避难所。
chunks: He was buried in Rome in the Protestant Cemetery,
whose cypresses cast their long shadows
over the graves of many distinguished foreigners
who have sought a last refuge
of health and peace under the skies of Italy.

text: Though at the time it created no great stir in the United States, it was most favorably received in England, where it paved the way for many pleasant and valuable acquaintanceships.
zh: 虽然当时它在美国没有引起太大的轰动，但它在英国受到了最热烈的欢迎，在那里它为许多愉快而有价值的熟人铺平了道路。
chunks: Though at the time it created no great stir
in the United States,
it was most favorably received in England,
where it paved the way
for many pleasant and valuable acquaintanceships.

text: For the general guardianship of these missions a garrison, or presidio, was in each case provided.
chunks: For the general guardianship
of these missions a garrison,
or presidio,
was in each case provided.

text: Indians were declared free of obligation to the friars; the latter were stripped of their temporal powers, their funds seized under the guise of a loan, and their establishments often subjected to what was little short of pillage.
zh: 印第安人被宣布对修道士不承担任何义务；后者被剥夺了世俗权力，他们的资金以贷款为幌子被没收，他们的机构常常遭到掠夺。
chunks: Indians were declared free of obligation to the friars;
the latter were stripped of their temporal powers,
their funds seized under the guise
of a loan, and their establishments often subjected
to what was little short of pillage.

text: Though this book considers mainly the transition period, 1846-1856, its introduction gives an excellent survey of earlier years.
zh: 虽然本书主要考虑的是 1846 年至 1856 年这一过渡时期，但它的引言对早期时期进行了精彩的回顾。
chunks: Though this book considers mainly the transition period,
its introduction gives an excellent survey
of earlier years.

text: Much profitable class employment in the drawing of maps and the writing of brief themes dealing with various phases of the romantic history of California will suggest itself.
zh: 在绘制地图和撰写涉及加利福尼亚浪漫历史各个阶段的简短主题方面，许多有利可图的课堂工作将不言而喻。
chunks: Much profitable class employment
in the drawing of maps
and the writing of brief themes dealing
with various phases of the romantic history
of California will suggest itself.

text: Besides the interest which every one must feel in exhibitions of life in those forms in which he himself has never experienced it; there has been, of late years, a great deal of attention directed toward common seamen, and a strong sympathy awakened in their behalf.
chunks: Besides the interest which every one must feel
in exhibitions of life in those forms
in which he himself has never experienced it;
there has been, of late years, a great deal of attention directed
toward common seamen, and a strong sympathy awakened in their behalf.

text: The fourteenth of August was the day fixed upon for the sailing of the brig Pilgrim on her voyage from Boston round Cape Horn to the western coast of North America.
zh: 八月十四日是朝圣者号双桅船从波士顿绕合恩角前往北美西海岸的预定航行日期。
chunks: The fourteenth of August was the day fixed
upon for the sailing
of the brig Pilgrim on her voyage
from Boston round Cape Horn
to the western coast of North America.

text: I took leave of those of my friends who came to see me off, and had barely opportunity to take a last look at the city, and well-known objects, as no time is allowed on board ship for sentiment.
zh: 我告别了前来送行的朋友，由于船上没有时间感伤，我几乎没有机会最后看一眼这座城市和著名的物体。
chunks: I took leave of those of my friends who came
to see me off, and had barely opportunity
to take a last look
at the city, and well-known objects,
as no time is allowed on board ship for sentiment.

text: There is not so helpless and pitiable an object in the world as a landsman beginning a sailor's life.
zh: 世界上没有比开始水手生活的土地居民更无助和可怜的了。
chunks: There is not
so helpless
and pitiable an object
in the world
as a landsman beginning a sailor's life.

text: If we pull together, you'll find me a clever fellow; if we don't, you'll find me a bloody rascal.--That's all I've got to say.--Go below, the larboard watch!
zh: 如果我们齐心协力，你会发现我是个聪明人；如果我们不这样做，你就会发现我是个该死的流氓。--这就是我要说的。--去下面，左舷手表！
chunks: If we pull together,
you'll find me a clever fellow;
if we don't,
you'll find me a bloody rascal.--That's all I've got
to say.--Go below, the larboard watch!

text: In a few minutes eight bells were struck, the watch called, and we went below.
zh: 几分钟之内，钟声敲响了八声，值班时间也到了，我们就下到了下面。
chunks: In a few minutes eight bells were struck,
the watch called,
and we went below.

text: In a few minutes the slide of the hatch was thrown back, which let down the noise and tumult of the deck still louder, the loud cry of "All hands, ahoy! tumble up here and take in sail," saluted our ears, and the hatch was quickly shut again.
chunks: In a few minutes the slide of the hatch was thrown back,
which let down the noise and tumult
of the deck still louder, the loud cry of "All hands,
ahoy! tumble up here and take in sail,
" saluted our ears, and the hatch was quickly shut again.

text: I could not have been of much service, for I remember having been sick several times before I left the topsail yard.
zh: 我帮不了什么忙，因为我记得在离开中帆帆桁之前，我已经病过好几次了。
chunks: I could not have been
of much service,
for I remember having been sick several times
before I left the topsail yard.

text: When we came on deck at four o'clock, we found things much changed for the better.
zh: 当我们四点钟到达甲板时，我们发现情况发生了很大的变化。
chunks: When we came
on deck
at four o'clock,
we found things much changed
for the better.

text: Having called up the "idlers," namely carpenter, cook, steward, etc., and rigged the pump, we commenced washing down the decks.
zh: 召集了“闲人”，即木匠、厨师、管家等，并安装了水泵后，我们开始冲洗甲板。
chunks: Having called up the "idlers,
" namely carpenter, cook, steward, etc.,
and rigged the pump,
we commenced washing down the decks.

text: long-shore swash aboard of you.
zh: 长岸冲上你的船。
chunks: long-shore swash aboard
of you.

text: They were the ship Helen Mar, of New York, and the brig Mermaid, of Boston.
zh: 它们是纽约的海伦·玛号和波士顿的双桅船美人鱼号。
chunks: They were the ship Helen Mar,
of New York,
and the brig Mermaid,
of Boston.

text: She hailed us at first in French, but receiving no answer, she tried us in English.
zh: 她一开始用法语向我们打招呼，但没有得到回应，她尝试用英语跟我们打招呼。
chunks: She hailed us
at first in French,
but receiving no answer,
she tried us
in English.

text: The prime minister, the official organ, and the active and superintending officer, is the chief mate.
zh: 首相，官方机关，现役督军，为大副。
chunks: The prime minister,
the official organ,
and the active
and superintending officer,
is the chief mate.

text: He is one to whom little is given and of whom much is required.
zh: 他是一个得到很少，却被要求很多的人。
chunks: He is one
to whom little is given and of whom much is required.

text: A.M., till twelve, M.
zh: 上午，直到十二点，M.
chunks: A.M.,
till twelve, M.

text: The morning commences with the watch on deck's "turning-to" at day-break and washing down, scrubbing, and swabbing the decks.
zh: 早晨从黎明时分甲板上的值班开始，并冲洗、擦洗和擦拭甲板。
chunks: The morning commences
with the watch
on deck's "turning-to" at day-break
and washing down, scrubbing,
and swabbing the decks.

text: No conversation is allowed among the crew at their duty, and though they frequently do talk when aloft, or when near one another, yet they always stop when an officer is nigh.
zh: 执勤期间，船员之间不允许交谈，尽管他们经常在高空或彼此靠近时交谈，但当一名军官在附近时，他们总是会停下来。
chunks: No conversation is allowed
among the crew at their duty,
and though they frequently do talk
when aloft, or when near one another,
yet they always stop when an officer is nigh.

text: Another method of employing the crew is, "setting up" rigging.
zh: 使用船员的另一种方法是“设置”索具。
chunks: Another method
of employing the crew is,
"setting up" rigging.

text: I have done it in this place because, for some time, our life was nothing but the unvarying repetition of these duties, which can be better described together.
zh: 我在这个地方这样做是因为，有一段时间，我们的生活只不过是这些职责的不断重复，这些职责可以放在一起更好地描述。
chunks: I have done it
in this place because, for some time,
our life was nothing
but the unvarying repetition of these duties,
which can be better described together.

text: They were certainly very beautiful, but not equal to what has been said of them.
zh: 他们确实非常美丽，但并不像人们所说的那么美丽。
chunks: They were certainly very beautiful,
but not equal
to what has been said
of them.

text: When Monday comes, they put on their tarry trowsers again, and prepare for six days of labor.
zh: 星期一到来时，他们又穿上柏油长裤，准备六天的分娩。
chunks: When Monday comes, they put
on their tarry trowsers again,
and prepare
for six days
of labor.

text: We continued running dead before the wind, knowing that we sailed better so, and that clippers are fastest on the wind.
chunks: We continued running dead
before the wind,
knowing that we sailed better so,
and that clippers are fastest
on the wind.

text: After once crossing the line you can never be subjected to the process, but are considered as a son of Neptune, with full powers to play tricks upon others.
zh: 一旦越界，你将永远不会受到这个过程的影响，但会被视为海王星的儿子，拥有完全的权力来欺骗别人。
chunks: After once crossing the line you can never be subjected
to the process, but are considered
as a son of Neptune,
with full powers
to play tricks upon others.

text: Among other bad practices, he frequently slept on his watch, and having been discovered asleep by the captain, he was told that he would be turned off duty if he did it again.
zh: 除其他不良行为外，他经常在值班时睡觉，被船长发现睡着了，并告诉他，如果再这样做，他将被停职。
chunks: Among other bad practices, he frequently slept on his watch,
and having been discovered asleep
by the captain, he was told
that he would be turned off duty
if he did it again.

text: Mahon soger!" and other still more choice extracts from the sailor's vocabulary.
zh: Mahon soger！”以及其他更多选择摘自水手的词汇。
chunks: Mahon soger!"
and other still more choice extracts from the sailor's vocabulary.

text: We immediately took in studding-sails and hauled our wind, running in for the land.
zh: 我们立即收起支撑帆，拖着风，向陆地跑去。
chunks: We immediately took
in studding-sails
and hauled our wind,
running in
for the land.

text: After taking a new departure from Olinda, we kept off on our way to Cape Horn.
zh: 从奥林达重新出发后，我们继续前往合恩角。
chunks: After taking a new departure
from Olinda,
we kept
off on our way
to Cape Horn.

text: We sprang aloft immediately and furled the royals and top-gallant-sails, and took in the flying jib, hauled up the mainsail and trysail, squared the after yards, and awaited the attack.
zh: 我们立即跳到高处，收起皇家帆和上帆，收起飞行三角帆，拉起主帆和三角帆，调整后帆桁，等待攻击。
chunks: We sprang aloft immediately and furled the royals
and top-gallant-sails, and took in the flying jib,
hauled up the mainsail and trysail,
squared the after yards,
and awaited the attack.

text: As I had now become used to the vessel and to my duty, I was of some service on a yard, and could knot my reef-point as well as anybody.
zh: 由于我现在已经习惯了这艘船和我的职责，我在院子里提供了一些服务，并且可以像任何人一样打结我的礁石点。
chunks: As I had now become used
to the vessel and to my duty,
I was of some service on a yard,
and could knot my reef-point
as well as anybody.

text: We were glad to get a watch below, and put on our thick clothing, boots, and south-westers.
chunks: We were glad
to get a watch below,
and put
on our thick clothing, boots,
and south-westers.

text: [1] This word "lay," which is in such general use on board ship, being used in giving orders instead of "go"; as "Lay forward!
zh: [1] “lay”这个词在船上普遍使用，用于下达命令而不是“go”；如“向前躺！
chunks: [1] This word "lay, " which is
in such general use
on board ship, being used
in giving orders instead
of "go"; as "Lay forward!

text: Here comes the Cape Horn!" said the chief mate; and we had hardly time to haul down and clew up, before it was upon us.
zh: 合恩角来了！”大副说道；我们几乎没有时间把船拖下来并上岸，它就已经来到了我们面前。
chunks: Here comes the Cape Horn!" said the chief mate;
and we had hardly time
to haul down
and clew up,
before it was upon us.

text: The captain sent up the steward with a glass of grog to each of the watch; and all the time that we were off the Cape, grog was given to the morning watch, and to all hands whenever we reefed topsails.
zh: 船长派乘务员给每个值班人员一杯烈酒。在我们离开海角的整个过程中，晨间值班人员和收起中帆时的所有船员都会得到烈酒。
chunks: The captain sent up the steward with a glass of grog to each
of the watch; and all the time
that we were off the Cape,
grog was given to the morning watch,
and to all hands whenever we reefed topsails.

text: The calms here are unlike those in most parts of the world, for there is always such a high sea running, and the periods of calm are so short, that it has no time to go down; and vessels, being under no command of sails or rudder, lie like logs upon the water.
chunks: The calms here are unlike those in most parts of the world,
for there is always such a high sea running,
and the periods of calm are so short,
that it has no time to go down; and vessels,
being under no command of sails or rudder, lie like logs upon the water.

text: This was very well for Cape Horn, and we thought it a little remarkable that, as we had not had one unpleasant Sunday during the whole voyage, the only tolerable day here should be a Sunday.
zh: 这对合恩角来说非常好，我们认为有点奇怪的是，由于我们在整个航程中没有遇到一个不愉快的周日，所以这里唯一可以忍受的一天应该是周日。
chunks: This was very well for Cape Horn,
and we thought it a little remarkable that,
as we had not had one unpleasant Sunday
during the whole voyage,
the only tolerable day here should be a Sunday.

text: At this instant the chief mate, who was standing on the top of the windlass, at the foot of the spenser mast, called out, "Lay out there and furl the jib!
zh: 这时，站在起锚机顶部、斯宾塞桅杆底部的大副大声喊道：“躺在那儿，卷起三角帆！
chunks: At this instant the chief mate,
who was standing on the top
of the windlass, at the foot
of the spenser mast, called out, "Lay out there
and furl the jib!

text: We had now got hardened to Cape weather, the vessel was under reduced sail, and everything secured on deck and below, so that we had little to do but steer and to stand our watch.
zh: 我们现在已经适应了好望角的天气，船的风帆减少了，甲板上和下面的所有东西都固定好了，所以我们除了驾驶和值班之外几乎没有什么可做的。
chunks: We had now got hardened
to Cape weather, the vessel was
under reduced sail, and everything secured
on deck and below, so that we had little
to do but steer and to stand our watch.

text: Many a kid of beef have I seen rolling in the scuppers, and the bearer lying at his length on the decks.
zh: 我见过许多小牛肉在排水孔里滚动，搬运工则躺在甲板上。
chunks: Many a kid
of beef have I seen rolling
in the scuppers,
and the bearer lying
at his length on the decks.

text: At two, P.M., we saw a sail on our larboard beam, and at four we made it out to be a large ship, steering our course, under single-reefed topsails.
zh: 下午两点，我们看到左舷横梁上挂着一张帆，四点钟，我们发现它是一艘大船，在单帆中帆的作用下操纵着我们的航线。
chunks: At two, P.M., we saw a sail
on our larboard beam,
and at four we made it
out to be a large ship,
steering our course, under single-reefed topsails.

text: I thought everybody knew Job Terry," said a green-hand, who came in the boat, to me, when I asked him about his captain.
zh: 我以为每个人都认识乔布·特里，”当我向一位刚上船的新手问起他的船长时，他对我说道。
chunks: I thought everybody knew Job Terry,
" said a green-hand,
who came in the boat,
to me, when I asked him
about his captain.

text: I had been interested in the bird from descriptions which I had read of it, and was not at all disappointed.
zh: 我从读过的描述中对这只鸟很感兴趣，而且一点也不失望。
chunks: I had been interested
in the bird from descriptions
which I had read
of it, and was not
at all disappointed.

text: He was going aloft to fit a strap round the main top-mast-head, for ringtail halyards, and had the strap and block, a coil of halyards and a marline-spike about his neck.
zh: 他正要去高处，在主顶桅头上安装一条带子，用于环尾升降索，他把带子和滑轮、一卷升降索和一根马林鱼钉挂在脖子上。
chunks: He was going aloft
to fit a strap round the main top-mast-head,
for ringtail halyards, and had the strap
and block, a coil
of halyards and a marline-spike about his neck.

text: Then, too, at sea--to use a homely but expressive phrase--you miss a man so much.
zh: 然后，在海上——用一句朴素但富有表现力的短语——你也会非常想念一个男人。
chunks: Then, too,
at sea--to use a homely
but expressive phrase--you miss a man
so much.

text: There is more quietness and seriousness.
zh: 更多的是安静和严肃。
chunks: There is more quietness
and seriousness.

text: We had hardly returned on board with our sad report, before an auction was held of the poor man's clothes.
zh: 我们刚带着悲伤的报告回到船上，穷人的衣服就被拍卖了。
chunks: We had hardly returned
on board
with our sad report,
before an auction was held
of the poor man's clothes.

text: Another said that he never knew any good to come of a voyage made against the will, and the deceased man shipped and spent his advance and was afterwards very unwilling to go, but not being able to refund, was obliged to sail with us.
zh: 另一个人说，他从来不知道违背意愿的航行有什么好处，死者发了船，花掉了预付款，后来很不愿意去，但无法退款，只好和我们一起航行。
chunks: Another said that he never knew any good
to come of a voyage made against the will,
and the deceased man shipped and spent his advance
and was afterwards very unwilling to go, but not being able
to refund, was obliged to sail with us.

text: Are you sure o' dat?" said he.
chunks: Are you sure o'
dat?" said he.

text: He had heard of ships, too, beating up the gulf of Finland against a head wind, and having a ship heave in sight astern, overhaul and pass them, with as fair a wind as could blow, and all studding-sails out, and find she was from Finland.
zh: 他也听说过有船在芬兰湾顶着逆风航行，看到船尾有一艘船，在顺风的情况下检修并通过它们，所有的帆都扬起，发现她来自芬兰。
chunks: He had heard of ships, too, beating up the gulf
of Finland against a head wind, and having a ship heave
in sight astern, overhaul and pass them, with as fair a wind
as could blow, and all studding-sails out,
and find she was from Finland.

text: You wait till you've been to sea as long as I have, and you'll know.
zh: 等你和我一样出海久了，你就会知道了。
chunks: You wait till you've been
to sea
as long
as I have,
and you'll know.

text: The mountains seemed almost to hang over us, and apparently from the very heart there came out, at regular intervals, a loud echoing sound, which affected me as hardly human.
zh: 群山似乎几乎悬在我们头顶上，显然，从内心深处，每隔一段时间就会发出响亮的回声，这让我觉得几乎不像人类。
chunks: The mountains seemed almost
to hang over us, and apparently
from the very heart there came out,
at regular intervals, a loud echoing sound,
which affected me as hardly human.

text: The mountains were high, but not so overhanging as they appeared to be by starlight.
zh: 山虽高，但并不像星光下显得那样高耸入云。
chunks: The mountains were high,
but not so overhanging
as they appeared
to be
by starlight.

text: Englishman who had entered the Chilian navy--with a priest, half a dozen task-masters, and a body of soldiers, were stationed there to keep them in order.
zh: 加入智利海军的英国人——带着一名牧师、六名监工和一队士兵，驻扎在那里以维持秩序。
chunks: Englishman who had entered the Chilian navy--with a priest,
half a dozen task-masters,
and a body of soldiers,
were stationed there
to keep them in order.

text: The milk, which was the first we had tasted since leaving Boston, we soon despatched; a piece of the sandal wood I obtained, and learned that it grew on the hills in the centre of the island.
zh: 牛奶是我们离开波士顿后第一次尝到的，我们很快就送来了；我得到了一块檀香木，得知它生长在岛中心的山上。
chunks: The milk, which was the first we had tasted
since leaving Boston, we soon despatched; a piece
of the sandal wood I obtained,
and learned that it grew
on the hills in the centre of the island.

text: Cumberland bay) is the only one in the island; two small bights of land on each side of the main bay (sometimes dignified by the name of bays) being little more than landing-places for boats.
chunks: Cumberland bay) is the only one
in the island; two small bights of land
on each side of the main bay (sometimes dignified
by the name of bays) being little more
than landing-places for boats.

text: Of the wood I can only say, that it appeared to be abundant; the island in the month of November, when we were there, being in all the freshness and beauty of spring, appeared covered with trees.
chunks: Of the wood I can only say,
that it appeared to be abundant; the island
in the month of November, when we were there,
